jobs.description:
As Strategic Buyer (d/f/m) in Hamburg Finkenwerder, you will take on a responsible procurement role within the cabin equipment sector. Your focus will be on sourcing, supplier management, and contract administration throughout the entire supply chain.

Your tasks:

- You support procurement planning and the selection of suitable suppliers for galleys and catering equipment.
- You assist in tendering activities, compare supplier proposals, and contribute to cost analyses to support sound commercial purchasing decisions.

- Completed bachelor's degree, for example in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or International Management.

- Structured, independent, and results-oriented way of working, with a focus on deadlines, quality, and business objectives.
- Strong communication skills for collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word; initial experience with SAP and Google Workspace is advantageous.
- Business-fluent English is required; German is considered an asset.
- Working hours: Full-time position with 35 hours per week.

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 72.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.occupation: Cabin Integration Engineer (d/f/m) AIRBUS (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Cabin Integration Engineer (d/f/m) in Finkenwerder for a full-time position within Airbus. This is an excellent opportunity for a configuration management specialist, cabin configuration manager, or aircraft customization coordinator who would like to contribute to cabin and cargo configuration topics as part of a transnational team.

Your tasks:

- Serve as the central contact for all cabin configuration-related matters across several ATA systems and ensure that aircraft configuration at modification level aligns with customer requests.
- Assist with the configuration integration of late mandatory customer option requests and ensure customer definitions are delivered on schedule and with the required quality.
- Ensure that the relevant EPAC/TDUs, product offers, bricks, and MOD build-ups are ready for the applicable Head of Version rebuilds and the related Custom Definition Freeze agenda.
- Track the availability and quality of customization modifications in the Aircraft Configuration Control database and support dependable Request for Change coverage.
- Prepare MOD build-ups for pre-development packages for larger projects and support project and chief engineering teams in reducing risks in new developments.
- Help drive digitalisation, Lean opportunities, and process simplification to enhance configuration integration deliverables, rate adaptability, and customer satisfaction.
- Collaborate closely with international stakeholders in Finkenwerder and contribute to the ongoing improvement of configuration processes, tools, and workflow efficiency.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Degree in engineering, aerospace engineering, business informatics, or a comparable technical field, ideally at bachelor's level or above.
- Early professional experience in configuration management, project management, process management, or a related aviation environment is an advantage.
- Basic understanding of cabin design, customization processes, and change management is desirable.
- Good IT skills, including MS Office and common collaboration tools; experience with ICC, Taksy/Gesy/Tesy, or Google Workspace.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a transnational team setting.
- Open-minded approach, high motivation, and the confidence to question existing practices and contribute to improvements.
- Ability to manage periods of high workload in a dynamic environment while remaining thorough and dependable.
- Work Hours: Full-time, 35 hours per week.
- Very good command of English is required, German at least at a good working level.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 80.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.description:

- Analyze, evaluate, and technically approve jigs, tools, and manufacturing aids.
- Act as the technical interface to suppliers within project activities and support supplier management.

- 3 years of professional experience, ideally in tooling, tool development, or manufacturing engineering.
- Good knowledge of CATIA, 3DX, or comparable design environments.
- Experience in supplier management, supplier coordination, and technical collaboration with external partners.
- Practical experience in project management, requirements management, and structured design planning.
- Strong understanding of process analysis, manufacturing optimization, and the implementation of technical solutions.
- Very good German and English language skills.
- Full-time position with a 35-hour work week.
- Willingness to undertake occasional business travel (approximately two to three trips per year).
- Strong organizational skills, high self-motivation, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under time pressure.
- Initial experience with Click'n Buy and Google Workspace is considered an advantage.
Benefits:

Our benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 64.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.occupation: Research Software Engineer (all genders) HPC Code Performance Optimisation (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position as

Research Software Engineer (all genders)

HPC Code Performance Optimisation

Your tasks

DKRZ plays a significant role in a number of projects with the aim of advancing Earth System Modelling (ESM). This facilitates the advancement of scientific knowledge in the fields of Earth system modelling and climate research. In the context of the current development of digital twins of the Earth, it is necessary to adapt increasingly complex models and corresponding software to the most powerful HPC systems in Europe and ensure that those codes run stable and efficiently.

As a member of the team of Research Software Engineers (RSEs), you will collaborate with Earth System scientists to overcome technical challenges in high-performance computing (HPC) and software development. Your responsibilities will include further developing, testing and optimising existing coupled Earth System models. This will allow them to be extended with new components (e.g. ice sheet models) without compromising the efficient execution time. This is a key challenge, given the need to use resources effectively on current and future HPC systems. For this position, we are looking for candidates who are interested in the interdisciplinary implementation of Earth System models and who want to apply their programming skills to new challenges.

Qualifications / Experiences

•Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering or related fields with a focus on scientific computing

•Strong interest in and experience with HPC-systems and parallel programming with MPI/OpenMP

•Knowledge of programming with C/C++ and/or Fortran under UNIX/LINUX and scripting languages

•Experience in the use and programming of GPU systems for scientific applications is an advantage

•Experience in algorithms, data structures and design of scientific software is welcome

•Very good communication skills and knowledge of English

Employment conditions

We offer opportunities to work in interdisciplinary teams and have excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific implementation and support requirements from our users and project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to work creatively at the interface between applied computer science and the development of scientific applications. Attendance at international conferences, project meetings and hackathons facilitate further training and the presentation of your own results.

Our company is headquartered in Hamburg, but we are committed to creating a flexible working environment. We offer a remote working option, with the possibility of working from home up to 100% within Germany. Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. The ideal commencement date would be September 2026, although this is flexible and can be discussed on an individual basis. The position is funded by a third-party project, with a limited initial timeframe until the end of 2028.

Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portalhttps://dkrz.softgarden.io/en/vacancies

Application deadline: Open until filled. Priority will be given to applications received by 23 August 2026

Questions? Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.

HENNIG ARZNEIMITTEL, headquartered in Flörsheim am Main, is a modern, medium-sized pharmaceutical company with over 300 employees and part of the Italian family-owned Final Group. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an employee (m/f/div) for the position of Legal & Compliance Officer / Specialist (m/f/d)

Job overview

The Legal & Compliance Officer / Specialist serves as a trusted business partner to management and internal stakeholders, providing legal guidance and ensuring that business activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, industry standards and internal policies. The role supports the development of a strong governance and compliance culture while enabling sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

- Provide day-to-day legal and compliance advice to executive management and all functions (Production, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, HR, Commercial and Business Development, Finance, etc.);
- Draft, review and support the negotiation of commercial agreements, including NDAs, licensing, supply, distribution, developing, service and manufacturing agreements and other legal documents;
- Monitor applicable laws, regulations and industry standards, assessing their impact on the company’s business activities;
- Develop, implement and continuously improve legal, compliance and corporate governance policies and procedures and internal controls;
- Ensure compliance with applicable pharmaceutical and healthcare regulations, including pharmaceutical advertising, interactions with healthcare professionals and healthcare organisations, anti-bribery and anti-corruption requirements, data protection regulations and relevant industry codes.
- Develop and execute compliance monitoring activities, compliance audits and risk assessments, ensuring appropriate corrective and preventive actions where required;
- Promote a strong culture of integrity and compliance through training, communication and awareness initiatives across the organization;
- Manage intellectual property matters, legal documentation systems and contract lifecycle management;
- Coordinate litigation, disputes and external legal counsel as required and act as the primary interface to the Holding’s Legal & Compliance function.

Your Profile

- Master’s degree in Law or equivalent legal qualification
- 4-5 years of professional experience in Legal and Compliance within the pharmaceutical, healthcare or another highly regulated industry
- Solid understanding of pharmaceutical regulations, healthcare compliance requirements, data protection laws and corporate governance principles
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to provide pragmatic, solution-oriented legal advice while effectively managing legal and compliance risks
- High level of integrity, independence, sound judgement and professional credibility
- Excellent knowledge of English and German, both written and spoken, Italian is an advantage
- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and management levels
- Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is preferred

What we offer

- A truly strategic leadership role with high visibility and direct impact on company growth
- Close collaboration with an international group structure (Italian parent company)
- Entrepreneurial environment with significant scope for shaping the function and processes
- Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives
- Up to 2 days of remote work per week
